overrideProperties.Name: Peltor ComTac VI headset (Coyote)
overrideProperties.Description: An improved version of the ComTac V communication headset, equipped with advanced environmental listening settings and an NIB (Natural Interaction Behavior) feature, allowing to communicate with other ComTac VI users in a certain proximity without having to use radios. Manufactured by 3M Peltor. Coyote Brown version. (Coyote)
